parentInfo.title: Admissions and enrolment
parentInfo.description: For admission requirements, availability and enrolment dates, please contact the school office.
parentInfo.description_zu: Ukuze uthole izidingo zokwamukelwa, izikhala nezinsuku zokubhalisa, sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lesikole.
parentInfo.description_st: Bakeng sa litlhoko tsa kamohelo, libaka tse teng le matsatsi a ngoliso, ka kopo ikopanye le ofisi ea sekolo.

parentInfo.title: School uniform
parentInfo.description: Please contact the school to confirm current uniform requirements and approved suppliers.
parentInfo.description_zu: Sicela uxhumane nesikole ukuze uqinisekise izidingo zamanje zomfaniswano nabahlinzeki abagunyaziwe.
parentInfo.description_st: Ka kopo ikopanye le sekolo ho netefatsa litlhoko tsa seaparo sa sekolo le barekisi ba lumelletsoeng.

parentInfo.title: Stationery and learning materials
parentInfo.description: Contact the relevant class teacher or school office for the latest stationery list.
parentInfo.description_zu: Xhumana nothisha wekilasi noma nehhovisi lesikole ukuze uthole uhlu lwakamuva lwezinto zokubhala.
parentInfo.title_st: Libuka le lisebelisoa tsa ho ithuta
parentInfo.description_st: Ikopanye le mosuoe oa sehlopha kapa ofisi ea sekolo bakeng sa lenane la morao-rao la lisebelisoa tsa sekolo.

parentInfo.title: Attendance and punctuality
parentInfo.description: Regular attendance and arriving on time help learners benefit fully from teaching and learning.
parentInfo.description_zu: Ukuya esikoleni njalo nokufika ngesikhathi kusiza abafundi bazuze ngokugcwele ekufundiseni nasekufundeni.
parentInfo.title_st: Ho ba teng sekolong le ho fihla ka nako
parentInfo.description_st: Ho ea sekolong kamehla le ho fihla ka nako ho thusa baithuti ho rua molemo thutong.

faqs.question: How do I contact the school?
faqs.answer: Call 078 589 5953 or 082 557 1288, or use the email addresses listed on this website.
faqs.answer_zu: Shayela ku-078 589 5953 noma ku-082 557 1288, noma usebenzise amakheli e-imeyili akule webhusayithi.
faqs.answer_st: Letsetsa 078 589 5953 kapa 082 557 1288, kapa sebelisa liaterese tsa lengolo-tsoibila tse fumanehang webosaeteng ena.

faqs.question: Where is the school located?
faqs.answer: Itemoheng Primary School is at 1190 Drieziek 4, Orange Farm, Gauteng.
faqs.answer_zu: I-Itemoheng Primary School iku-1190 Drieziek 4, Orange Farm, eGauteng.
faqs.answer_st: Itemoheng Primary School e fumaneha 1190 Drieziek 4, Orange Farm, Gauteng.

faqs.question: Where can I get the current school calendar?
faqs.answer: Please contact the school office for the latest approved calendar and term dates.
faqs.answer_zu: Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lesikole ukuze uthole ikhalenda egunyaziwe yakamuva nezinsuku zethemu.
faqs.question_st: Nka fumana khalendara ea sekolo ea hajoale hokae?
faqs.answer_st: Ka kopo ikopanye le ofisi ea sekolo bakeng sa khalendara e amohetsoeng le matsatsi a kotara ea sekolo.
